from scipy import ndimage
mask = a!=5
lab,n=ndimage.label(mask, structure=np.ones((3,3)))
comps=[]
for i in range(1,n+1):
    ys,xs=np.where(lab==i)
    if len(ys)<2: continue
    r0,r1,c0,c1=ys.min(),ys.max(),xs.min(),xs.max()
    comps.append((i,r0,r1,c0,c1,len(ys)))
for c in sorted(comps,key=lambda t:(t[1],t[3])):
    i,r0,r1,c0,c1,sz=c
    print(f"comp{i} rows{r0}-{r1} cols{c0}-{c1} size{sz}")
    for r in range(r0,r1+1):
        print('  '+''.join(str(x) if x!=5 else '.' for x in a[r][c0:c1+1]))
